integrity: Exact finite construction and elementary collapses reproduced by an included standard-library checker; no independent mathematical audit or external formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the seven-vertex complete graph and its full label-dihedral action. Does not assert the original quotient is homeomorphic to a sphere or classify other sizes. Original preprint date for Bouc not located, so first-public evidence uses the historical bibliographic publication record; the earliest recovered publicly posted full source is a 1992 article.
title: A sphere survives the full dihedral quotient of the seven-point matching complex
